newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: CRICKET-SRI LANKA WIN TOSS, PUT INDIA IN TO BAT.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-SRI LANKA WIN TOSS, PUT INDIA IN TO BAT.

text.p: Sri Lanka won the toss and put India into bat in the third match of the sixth Asia Cup tournament at Colombo's R. Premadasa stadium on Friday.

Sri Lanka - Arjuna Ranatunga (captain), Sanath Jayasuriya, Mavan Atapattu, Aravinda de Silva, Roshan Mahanama, Kumara Dharmasena, Ruwan Kalpage, Chaminda Vaas, Muthiah Muralitharan, Sajeeva de Silva, Lanka de Silva.
India: Sachin Tendulkar (captain), Saurav Ganguly, Rahul Dravid, Mohammad Azharuddin, Ajay Jadeja, Robin Singh, Saba Karim, Anil Kumble, Venkatesh Prasad, Abey Kuruvila, Noel David.
